architectural_notes: App depends on an external PDF export library that must be loaded/initialized before quote-to-PDF printing works.
Rate card updates are sent to an Internet Computer canister method `updateRateCard`; service availability impacts CSV upload.
known_issues: PDF export library not loaded; cannot print generated quote to PDF.
Uploading rate card .csv fails: IC0508 non_replicated_rejection reject_code 5 because canister s2z5l-zqaaa-aaaai-atqza-cai is stopped.

existing_features.title: Make PDF export work reliably by bundling and loading the PDF libraries within the app (jsPDF and the autoTable plugin) instead of depending on global CDN scripts (window.jspdf), so users can export a generated quote to a PDF without seeing the error "PDF export library is not loaded".

Update the HTML entry point and/or PDF export utility so there is a single, consistent source of truth for PDF library loading (avoid double-loading via both CDN scripts and bundled imports), preventing runtime mismatches where the autoTable plugin is missing.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix PDF export: ensure PDF export library loads so users can print generated quotes to PDF
Fix rate card CSV upload failing with IC0508 'Canister is stopped' during updateRateCard

projectName: Fix PDF export by ensuring jsPDF library is reliably loaded
